FaceGen coefficient generator: resizes all four matrices, then writes base[i] + FaceGen_RandomStandardNormal()*geneticVariation*1.5 for every coefficient. The normal call at 0x6EE070 is the only normal source in this pass.

FaceGen random-generator method. Copies all four base matrices and adds independent N(0,1) * geneticVariation * 1.5 to every coefficient. The manager subobject passed in ECX is not otherwise referenced.
comment_repeatable: Resize and randomize all four FaceGen matrices. Output allocation uses unchecked 32-bit rows*columns, but nested writes use the original dimensions; malformed race data can therefore wrap the allocation count and overrun the output vector.
